queries.sql:
SELECT c.customer_city AS city, count(*) AS customer_rows,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01') AS q1_all_status_orders,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01') AS q2_all_status_orders,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')) AS q2_gmv_eligible_orders
 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o USING(customer_id)
 WHERE c.customer_city IN ('sao paulo','rio de janeiro') GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY c.customer_city

SELECT c.customer_city AS city, count(*) AS q2_gmv_item_rows
 FROM customers c JOIN orders o USING(customer_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
 WHERE c.customer_city IN ('sao paulo','rio de janeiro') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY c.customer_city
